title: Last Request
html:
Quest Giver: --

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Collect 3 Soldier's Badges. They can be found in Algernon

Quest Reward: 1250 Gold and 1 Kings Coin

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: Yes

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Recover Dead KENNI Badges and return them to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

Dungeon Runner, you're just in time to help me! Thank Gosh you found me here. I was leading a training mission for Townston's newest recruits and it went bad. Real bad. It was supposed to be an easy assignment: come to lower Algernon, clean up some fire Mutants and then go home. It didn't go off that way though. The horror. The horror.

I thought they were ready. They were only Kingdom Entry-level Noobs Nearing Induction--we call them K.E.N.N.I.s for short. The mutants came out of nowhere, it was horrible! The noise, the shouting of the poor, green recruits and the smell of burning hair! And then...silence. We never expected they would be so attracted to fireworks. I brought them for fun, to celebrate the recruits getting their badges. See my badge? It's what we get when we become soldiers. And these recruits had just been pinned. They killed my KENNIs! Those Mutants of questionable parentage!!

I'm sorry. I'll be better soon. But KENNIs deserved better. They were slow-roasted. I even saw the Mutants pull out seven different kinds of herbs. And spices too! I need you to get down into some of the lower one-off dungeons and get their KENNI Badges back. When you collect them, bring them up to the Townston Commander, he'll see they'll go to the right place. You'll want to look for the extra-big Mutants, the boss ones. You can identify them because their feet are on fire.

Turn-in:

Thank you, Dungeon Runner.

Oooo did you bring me presents? That was very thoughtful of you. Oh it was someone named Kenny who got them? Well that's nice of him. High five?

Objectives:

  • Recovered KENNI Badges ×12

Level range: 5–20
